mentions.name: Fil-GNOME (GNOME ported to Fil-C)
mentions.description: A port of the GNOME desktop environment to Fil-C. The port is starting to work but with some features still disabled; the Rust-to-Fil-ABI interop work is intended to get librsvg working in Fil-GNOME.
mentions.source_excerpt: finishing porting GNOME to Fil-C. It is starting to work but with some features still disabled.
